published_by: DESNZ (formerly BEIS), 'Greenhouse gas reporting: conversion factors', one set per reporting year (gov.uk collection 'government-conversion-factors-for-company-reporting')
what_this_is: THE PUBLISHED FACTOR, NOT A READING OF IT. DESNZ's Scope 1 natural-gas factor for each reporting year: Fuels > Gaseous fuels > Natural gas, unit kWh (Gross CV), kgCO2e. Combustion at the point of use only. Well-to-tank is a separate DESNZ factor and is not in this file.

basis.units: kgCO2e per kWh, gross calorific value -- GB gas is billed in kWh converted at gross CV
basis.year_key: the DESNZ reporting year whose factor set states the value
basis.scope: Scope 1 combustion only; CO2e, not the CO2-only column the same sheet also carries

provenance_legend.transcribed: read from that year's DESNZ flat file (2021 from the full set's Fuels sheet) by the 2026-10-05 knowledge pass and transcribed in docs/market_research/household_carbon_and_the_measures_that_save_it.md section 2; the per-year file URL was not recorded. Asserted as an equality by the year-keyed rate census.

r13_wall: Published conversion factors, transcribed blind to company results. No value here may be moved because a carbon figure looks wrong.
portability: One factor per reporting year. Another market supplies its own artefact behind the same loader.
open_items: 2022: both DESNZ 2022 spreadsheets failed to parse; bracketed by 2021 (0.18316) and 2023 (0.18293) and deliberately absent, never borrowed.
Per-year source URLs to be recorded on the next read, which would lift these entries to a primary level.

source_check.publication: DESNZ, 'UK government conversion factors for company reporting of greenhouse gas emissions' (gov.uk collection; one factor set per reporting year)
source_check.how_to_recheck: GET https://www.gov.uk/api/content/government/collections/government-conversion-factors-for-company-reporting and read `public_updated_at`. A later value means a set was added or revised; DESNZ publishes a new year's set each June, which adds a year to this artefact rather than changing an old one. The token was read on 2026-10-05; the factor values themselves were read by the 2026-10-05 knowledge pass (see the legend).

checked_for_supersession.note: collection page date read from the gov.uk content API on 2026-10-05; the 2026 set (June 2026) is not yet transcribed and is a new year, not a revision of the years held.
